observations.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'href')
observations.origin: Satori's bundled HarfBuzz Emscripten glue in node_modules/satori/dist/standalone.js: B=typeof WorkerGlobalScope<"u" is true in workerd, so it runs A=self.location.href, and Workers define no location. The glue is an async factory invoked when satori/standalone is imported; its rejection is cached and surfaces on every render, so every request returns 500.

observations.step: probe: globalThis.location defined before rendering (diagnostic only, not part of the fixture)
observations.error: RuntimeError: Aborted(CompileError: WebAssembly.instantiate(): Wasm code generation disallowed by embedder)
observations.origin: The glue then compiles HarfBuzz from bytes embedded in the bundle (function J(){return r("hb.wasm")} with embedded bytes D, then WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, ...)). Workers allow WebAssembly.instantiate only with a pre-compiled WebAssembly.Module.

run.sourceMapNote: Wrangler source maps attribute the glue to harfbuzzjs 0.10.0 (patched) vendored inside satori (satori/src/harfbuzz.ts).

satoriVersionSurvey.question: Does any Satori version usable with metaplate/edge shape text on Workers?
findings: 0.35.2 and later: export ./layout.wasm (required by metaplate/edge) and ship the bundled HarfBuzz Emscripten glue that reads self.location.href in a WorkerGlobalScope and compiles hb.wasm from embedded bytes.
0.33.5 to 0.35.1: import the harfbuzzjs package instead and export ./yoga.wasm, not ./layout.wasm, so metaplate/edge cannot use them.
Satori's init(input) accepts only layout.wasm; there is no option to pass a precompiled HarfBuzz module.
satoriVersionSurvey.conclusion: No Satori version usable with metaplate/edge shapes text on Cloudflare Workers today.

rerunWithExplanation.change: fix(edge): metaplate/edge rethrows both HarfBuzz failures as an Error naming the limitation, with the original as cause
rerunWithExplanation.packedFrom: branch fix/edge-workers-harfbuzz working tree before commit
rerunWithExplanation.bodyFirstLine: Error: metaplate/edge cannot render text in this runtime: Satori's bundled HarfBuzz text shaper compiles WebAssembly at runtime and expects self.location, which this runtime forbids (Cloudflare Workers and other V8 isolates that disallow Wasm code generation). metaplate/edge runs on edge runtimes that allow it, such as Deno and Netlify Edge Functions. See https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate#edge-runtimes-with-metaplateedge
rerunWithExplanation.consoleCause: Caused by: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'href')

relatedPlatforms.netlifyEdge: Deno-based; allows run-time Wasm compilation and exposes location, so Satori's HarfBuzz starts. Hosted-certified on 2026-11-01 (netlify-edge).
relatedPlatforms.vercelEdge: Vercel documents that WebAssembly.instantiate on the Edge runtime requires the Wasm source to be provided with the import statement, not a buffer, so the same failure is expected. Not observed: the 2026-11-01 deployment was refused for size (2.13 MB gzip against Hobby's 1 MB) before any render ran (vercel-edge).
